name: FrenchModelVariant452_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant452_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the command row at data + 0xFC indexed by the request and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the sheet and streamer helpers from the configuration start and the line helper once the phase is positive; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-variant452.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-435 images build the same source through model_variant/variant435_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512, and bind the helpers and the data block (0x5C lower; the PAL images bind it 0xA30 bytes into the unclassified tail) at their own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
